page_number_gaps: No gaps within the selected first-10 window: pages 104404-104413 (OR1-1 through OR1-10) are fully contiguous.

Just outside the selected window: OR1-11 is absent from CrossRef results -- the page sequence jumps directly from 104413 (OR1-10) to 104414, which is titled 'OR1-12'. This is consistent with OR1-11 having been withdrawn before publication; it does not affect the required 10-abstract batch.
notes.discovery_scope_finding: IMPORTANT: CrossRef volume 5, issue 4 of JSCAI is NOT a pure conference-abstract supplement -- it is the journal's regular April 2026 monthly issue, which happens to co-publish the SCAI 2026 Scientific Sessions abstracts alongside regular journal content. Of the 864 works in this volume/issue, 834 are conference abstracts identifiable by a session-code title prefix (e.g. 'OR1-1 | ...', matching Confex's own 'Oral Abstract'/'Poster Abstract' GoodType categories confirmed via the site's search-filter form), while the remaining 30 are non-abstract items -- original research articles, case reports, editorials, a letter-to-the-editor response, a corrigendum, and front/back matter (Cover, Title Page, Table of Contents, Category Index) -- that were never entered into the Confex conference program and would spuriously FAIL every match attempt if included. Since the runbook's objective is specifically the conference's accepted posters/abstracts, the agent selected the first 10 entries from the abstract subset (sorted by page number ascending, which for this subset happens to align exactly with the session numbering: OR1-1 through OR1-10) rather than the literal first 10 by page number across the full mixed issue. This is a deliberate scope interpretation, not a data-quality failure; see summary.md Recommendations for detail.
